idea-plugin.name: Width Separator
idea-plugin.description:
Width Separator shows a vertical guide at a file-specific column in test data files.

The guide is shown for .input and .output files that declare the column with a // MAX_WIDTH N comment on its own line, for example // MAX_WIDTH 100.

Editors of .input files also get a button in their top right corner that opens the matching Name.new.output file in a split to the right, creating it if it does not exist yet.

action.text: Open Expected Output in Right Split
action.description: Creates Name.new.output next to Name.input and opens it in a split to the right
